scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] separates snorkeling and wet-phone protection, beach and shopping carry, a twenty-liter daypack, and one resort-evening carrier into distinct roles, choosing materials that fit each use without letting the nested bags dominate the flight luggage.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]把浮潜与手机防水、海滩与购物携带、20 升日用背包以及度假村晚间小包分成不同角色，并选择适合各自用途、又不会让这些内嵌包具挤占主行李的材质。
examples: using Nylon, Polyester, Plastic, or Other Synthetic for the wet-side dry bag or packable day carrier
using Canvas, Cotton, or Straw for a reusable shopping or beach tote when packability and resort appearance allow
using Leather, Faux Leather, Silk, Velvet, or Beaded construction only for the small evening carrier that stays away from snorkeling gear

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Drawing on prior hiking experience, [X] reroutes a one-week July trip to the Larapinta Trail and chooses a pack construction for repeated four-to-six-liter water loads, abrasive dry ground, sweat, cold nights, unreliable resupply, and field inspection of liners and reservoirs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 凭借以往的徒步经验，[X]把七月的一周行程改到 Larapinta Trail，并围绕每天反复携带 4 至 6 升水、干燥粗糙地面、汗液、寒冷夜晚、补水点不可靠，以及途中检查内衬和水袋等条件选择背包结构材质。
examples: using Nylon or Polyester for a light body that must tolerate repeated load and abrasion
using Mesh only on ventilating zones that will not scrape against rock or hold sharp gear
using Plastic or Other Synthetic liners and reservoirs where leak checks, replacement, and water isolation matter

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When buying one backpack for a two-week trip that includes hiking, [X] compares body materials only after capacity and harness fit are settled, balancing low carried mass, rain response, field drying, abrasion, reinforcement, and the ability to inspect construction before purchase.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为包含徒步的两周旅行购买一只背包时，[X]在容量和背负贴合度确定后才比较包身材质，并权衡自重、遇雨表现、途中干燥速度、耐磨性、加固需求，以及购买前检查做工的便利性。
examples: using Nylon when very low weight and water resistance lead the decision
using Polyester when durable everyday use and budget availability are the better balance
using Other Synthetic reinforcement only at high-wear panels instead of adding it everywhere

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After recently starting to commute by public transport, [X] evaluates one named Swissgear laptop backpack through daily use, separating the water-resistant body from breathable contact panels, padding, stitching, and zipper hardware while judging heat, light rain, cleaning, and months of repeated loading.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始乘公共交通通勤后，[X]通过日常使用评估一款有明确型号的 Swissgear 笔记本电脑背包，把防泼水包身、透气接触面、填充层、缝线和拉链五金分别看待，并考察闷热、小雨、清洁以及数月反复装载后的表现。
examples: using Mesh on the back and straps where airflow and body contact are the observed need
using Nylon, Polyester, or Other Synthetic for the main body only when it preserves the stated water resistance and durability
using Metal hardware where repeated zipper operation benefits from strength without treating the entire backpack as metal

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When cooked pasta cannot be refrigerated overnight, [X] builds a safer work-lunch system around morning assembly or shelf-stable food and an insulated carrier with ice packs, comparing shell, lining, and insulation materials by cleanability, condensation, leakage, and cold retention.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 煮好的意面无法冷藏过夜时，[X]改用清晨组装或常温稳定食品，并配合冰袋与保温午餐包建立更安全的工作午餐系统；包的外壳、内衬和保温层材质要按易清洁性、冷凝水、渗漏与保冷效果分别比较。
examples: using Polyester or Nylon for a light outer shell that tolerates repeated commuting
using Plastic for a wipe-clean liner that contains condensation around ice packs
using Other Synthetic insulation when cold retention is verified without making the bag unnecessarily bulky

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before an R&B stadium concert, [X] checks a strict clear-bag policy and chooses a carrier whose transparent body, strap, and hardware can pass entry while remaining light enough for dancing and secure enough for a visible phone.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场 R&B 体育场演唱会前，[X]会核对严格的透明包规定，并选择一只透明包身、肩带和五金都能通过入场检查的包；它还要足够轻便以便跳舞，并能妥善收住清晰可见的手机。
examples: using clear Plastic, vinyl, or PVC-like Other Synthetic only when the venue accepts that construction
using Polyester or Nylon webbing for a light crossbody strap that stays in front
using limited Metal chain or closure hardware when it remains comfortable and does not conflict with security screening

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] narrows a pictured suitcase purchase to a twenty-four-inch hard-shell candidate for a two-week international trip, then checks whether its impact protection, water handling, easy stain removal, warranty, and durability in repeated airport use justify the shell's empty weight.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]把图中行李箱的购买范围缩小到适合两周国际旅行的 24 英寸硬壳候选款，并判断它的抗冲击、防泼水、易清洁、保修和反复托运耐用性，是否足以抵消硬壳增加的空箱重量。
examples: using Plastic when a polycarbonate hard shell supplies the stated lightness and protection
using Other Synthetic only when the seller identifies a different technical shell and its behavior is verified
rejecting a heavier rigid construction when protection gains do not justify the user's explicit empty-weight concern

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a planned Buenos Aires souvenir stop, [X] compares bags across San Telmo's artisan stalls, Calle Florida shops, and an upscale gallery, checking labels, edges, stitching, smell, finish, and seller claims before paying a premium for material presented as local leatherwork.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在计划好的布宜诺斯艾利斯纪念品采购中，[X]会比较圣特尔莫手作摊位、佛罗里达街商店与高档商场里的包具，并在为号称本地皮具的材质支付溢价前，检查标签、切边、缝线、气味、表面处理和卖家说法。
examples: choosing Leather when construction and labeling support the promised local leather good
choosing Faux Leather when the lower-cost alternative is represented honestly and its finish meets the intended use
choosing Canvas or Cotton for an artisan tote when textile construction matters more than a leather souvenir

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While developing a comic character sheet, [X] refines one worn village satchel so its main body, mismatched repairs, strap, and hanging wooden whistle consistently communicate long use and contrast with the city's sharper iridescent surfaces across later panels.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在制作漫画角色设定表时，[X]细化同一只磨旧的乡村挎包，使其包身、不同材质的补丁、肩带和悬挂的木哨在后续画格中持续传达长期使用痕迹，并与城市人物更锋利、虹彩般的表面形成对比。
examples: using Leather for the worn main body whose creases and edge wear must stay consistent
using Canvas or Denim for visible repair patches that distinguish maintenance history from the original body
using Metal only for small buckles or attachment points rather than replacing the source's wooden whistle

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Seeking a meaningful upgrade for an active friend, [X] first identifies whether the repeatedly used item is a worn wallet, college backpack, work or travel bag, or poorly ventilated gym bag, then requires the replacement material to solve the observed frustration rather than merely look more expensive.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 想为一位经常外出活动的朋友送出实用的升级礼物时，[X]会先确认对方反复使用且已经磨损的是钱包、学生背包、工作或旅行包，还是通风不佳的健身包，再要求替代材质真正解决已经观察到的问题，而不只是显得更昂贵。
examples: using Leather or honestly labeled Faux Leather when a slim wallet or professional bag needs a structured finish
using Canvas or Cotton when repairability and familiar soft carry matter for an everyday upgrade
using Polyester, Nylon, Mesh, or Other Synthetic when a gym or travel bag must improve ventilation, organization, and durability
